title: Building kit
description: A sheet of 16 px building pieces in the standard kit layout (*.kit.json); see Tools/Vulcanus/app/docs/building-editor.md.

id.description: Stable namespaced ID, for example base:roman_basic.

source.description: Project-relative path of the base sheet: a PNG or an Aseprite file.

variations.description: Variation ID (such as winter) to the project-relative path of a sheet in the same layout, drawn over the base.
